data.name: Highrollers
data.detailed_description:
Your Fate Is Your Weapon

Highrollers is a narrative-driven, top-down action RPG set in an alternative world where the Wild West meets experimental Tesla-inspired technology.

Play as Valentine J. Midnight, a gunslinger betrayed by the corporations that rule the New World. Hunt down powerful bosses, uncover the truth behind their empire, and ignite the spark of revolution.

Your greatest weapon is not just your gun.

Your greatest weapon is Fate.

(But you know, you can always use some firepower too)

Shape Your Fate

Fate is a powerful yet unpredictable device with six sides, each of which can be equipped with a different module.

Choose from more than 70 unlockable modules as you progress through the game. Customize Fate to match your playstyle with temporary power-ups, special abilities, and unconventional weapons.

Charge Fate during combat, roll the dice, and unleash the ability you receive at the right moment.

But Fate’s power always comes at a price. Every build must include a cursed module with a negative effect. Chips and upgrades can tilt the odds in your favor, but you can never control the outcome completely.

Shape the odds. Take the risk. Embrace the chaos.

Prepare for Every Hunt

Each boss has its own mechanics and a battlefield designed specifically around the encounter.

Before entering a fight, choose your two weapons, equip your Fate modules, and decide which items to bring with you. Use chips, outfits, and upgrades to take advantage of each boss’s weaknesses.

Preparation matters just as much as your reflexes.

The right strategy can turn a difficult battle in your favor. The wrong choices can make even the smallest mistake costly.

Return to Indigo Town

Your journey begins in Indigo Town, a frontier settlement transformed by the discovery of a mysterious indigo mine.

Return to town between missions. Upgrade your weapons, acquire new Fate modules, visit shops, speak with the locals, and unlock new missions.

As the story progresses, Indigo Town will change alongside you.

Meet new characters, uncover different stories, and witness the consequences of your choices in the streets of the town.

Ignite the Revolution

Led by D.I.C.E., the corporations use technology to keep the people of the New World under their control.

Join forces with the People’s Flush Gang. Explore the territories ruled by the corporations, complete side missions, and take down their most powerful figures one by one.

Valentine’s story begins with revenge.

But it may grow into something far greater.

Your Fate Is in Your Hands.

data.short_description: Step into a Western-Teslapunk world filled with poker chips, robots, gunslingers, and high-voltage technology. Face challenging bosses, customize your Fate device, rethink your strategy with every battle, and ignite a revolution against the corporations in power.
